entries.counter_meaning: Canonical per-player decision counter; distinct from the Engine-wide snapshot publication counter.
entries.evidence: TFTEngine maintains one player_decision_sequences counter per player and increments each on every published ResetResult/StepResult. The array is returned in native results, exposed in AuditSnapshot through pybind, and copied/validated by cpp_lobby_env._copy_player_decision_sequences into _last_snapshot_metadata. It is distinct from the Engine-wide observation-snapshot counter.

entries.counter_meaning: Exact observation and action-mask snapshot publication sequence shared by all eight player rows in one ResetResult or StepResult.
entries.reset_boundary: new_engine_instance; counter continues across episode resets within the same Engine instance
entries.evidence: PR #428 adds TFTEngine::Impl::decision_sequence to ResetResult/StepResult; it increments once per published native snapshot, survives reset, and is shared by all player rows. It is snapshot identity, not a per-player decision counter.
Current masks are retrieved separately and have no typed identity or payload hash envelope.

entries.reset_boundary: CI runtime reset on Engine reset is documented; exact counter restart/continuity needs runtime proof
entries.evidence: Audit identifies player-local CI sequence; it is not the Engine decision counter.
Distinct sequence domain identified by replay/producer-binding audits.
Distinct bridge/player sequence domain; not interchangeable with Engine or CI sequences.
Global append ordering is recorder metadata, not a game decision counter.
Viewer/session sequence is for correlation only and never replaces Engine identity.
Rollout timestep is training metadata, not source decision identity.

promotion_requirements: scope, monotonicity, duplicate-delivery and reset semantics proven
typed serialization at source and every transport boundary
stale, mismatch, reset and conflict tests
registry version increment and architecture reconstruction review

identity_scope_contract.match_id: Authoritative logical game-match identity from a validated game/platform source; never the ViewerSession UUID.
identity_scope_contract.engine_match_id: Canonical Engine-episode scope combining Engine-instance lifetime and native episode_id; episode_id alone is insufficient.
identity_scope_contract.session_match_id: ViewerSession UUID for recording/session correlation only; not part of canonical decision identity.
identity_scope_contract.episode_id: Native counter local to one TFTEngine::Impl lifetime; metadata only unless paired with Engine-instance scope.
identity_scope_contract.player_id: Episode-local native seat index encoded in v2 as player-0 through player-7; not a persistent player UUID.
